warnings.text:
warn: ExGrid.Components.ExGrid[0]
      ExGrid: ViewportHeight is Stretch, but the grid's parent gives it no height, so it is only as tall as its header and no row can be painted. Give the parent a definite height: pixels, a percentage of something definite, a grid track, or a flex item with min-height: 0 (ADR-0028).
